request.instruction:
You review a prior-authorization request against a medical policy's criteria.
For each criterion, decide from the evidence alone whether it is:
- "met": the evidence states that the criterion is satisfied,
- "not-met": the evidence states something that fails the criterion,
- "insufficient": the evidence does not say, or says it only vaguely, without a date, or as hearsay.
Cite every evidence reference you relied on, exactly as given (for example "DocumentReference/doc-1").
Never cite a reference that is not in the evidence list. Do not recommend an outcome.
Respond with JSON only:
{"findings": [{"criterionId": "...", "status": "met" | "not-met" | "insufficient", "evidence": ["..."], "rationale": "..."}]}

criteria.title: Positioning an ordinary bed cannot provide
criteria.requirement: The prescriber documents that the member must be positioned with the head raised 35 degrees or more, or in another position an ordinary bed cannot hold.

criteria.title: A diagnosis the positioning need follows from
criteria.requirement: The member has a recorded diagnosis that the prescriber links to the positioning need.

criteria.title: Position changes often enough to need a motor
criteria.requirement: The prescriber's note states that the position must change several times a day or without delay, which a manual crank cannot do.

evidence.text: Condition: I50.22 Chronic systolic (congestive) heart failure. Onset 2021-10-05.

Clinical note (Prescriber visit note, dated 2026-09-10T12:00:00Z):
Chronic systolic heart failure, stable.
He sleeps comfortably with the head raised about 20 degrees on two pillows.
The positioning need follows from his heart failure.
He wants to be able to raise and lower the head several times a night without getting up,
immediately when he wakes; he cannot work a manual crank.

value.rationale: The evidence states that the member sleeps comfortably with the head raised about 20 degrees, which fails the requirement that the member must be positioned with the head raised 35 degrees or more, or in another position an ordinary bed cannot hold.
The prescriber's note explicitly states that the positioning need follows from his heart failure.
The prescriber's note states that he wants to be able to raise and lower the head several times a night immediately when he wakes and cannot work a manual crank.
